Besides AirPods Pro 3 continuing to be $50 off, today's 9to5Toys afternoon deals also highlights the 46mm titanium Apple Watch Series 11 dropping $184, the aluminum cellular model dropping $130, and more starting from $299. Rare Apple keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals are somehow still live, we also have a deal on my personal favorite Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger, but the real focus in the accessories category today is Nomad's massive anniversary sitewide sale covering MagSafe chargers, cases, Find My tracking cards, Watch bands, and more rare deals. More details below.

Gear up for summer with AirPods Pro 3 now down to nearly $50 off, with more models from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 ($249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 ($129)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $149 ($179)

Back in stock: 46mm titanium Apple Watch Series 11 down to $184 off at Amazon

This deal sold out very quickly yesterday, so don't hesitate if you're interested today. Apple 46mm titanium GPS + Cellular Series 11 is once again on sale for $184 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular with Slate titanium case and black sport band at a shipped low of $564.97.

This is one of the top-end titanium case models, which carries an MSRP of $749. You'd be saving $184 off the sticker price during what could be a flash deal today, making it one of the best prices we've seen on this model. It briefly dipped to $550 just before Prime Day last month, but besides that this is the best price we've tracked on this configuration.

Just to reiterate, this deal is only for those who want the Slate titanium body – you'll still be paying more even with the discount. However, more popular aluminum Series 11 models are also down $100 and $130 this week:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 ($399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 ($429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular from $399 ($499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular from $399 ($529)

Rare Apple keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals somehow still live, with historic lows from $80

We certainly see plenty of deals on Apple's marquee tech – $50 off AirPods Pro 3, up to $130 off the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models – but Magic accessories are far less common. Yet we're somehow still seeing Prime Day pricing roll over onto the basic Magic Keyboard, full-size with Touch ID, and black Apple Magic Mouse.

Before these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on these Apple accessories have been very rare, and we cannot say how long these deals will last.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 ($99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 ($99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard full-size with Touch ID $145 ($179)

All three sit at the historic lowest prices we've tracked at Amazon. The black Apple Magic Mouse hasn't been on sale at this price in ages (I'd like to snag another as a spare myself), and both Magic Keyboard models are also at all-time lows – the basic model only hit this price once before today's discount, and the Touch ID model has never dropped below $158.

If you've been wanting to refresh your Apple Magic input devices, jump on these prices while Prime Day pricing is still in effect.

Nomad's massive anniversary sitewide deals now live: rare discounts on MagSafe chargers, cases, Watch bands, more

Rare 20% off! Nomad's gorgeous metal and glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands

There are plenty of cheaper 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands out there, but few look as nice or are as high quality as Nomad's latest models. They don't come cheap, but with the brand's official 2026 anniversary sale now live, both 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models are seeing rare discounts to power your entire Apple mobile kit.

Nomad's 2026 anniversary sale is officially live with discounts on a slew of iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories, with the Stand One and Stand One Max among the rarest of deals:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One $103 ($129)
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max $135 ($169)

These are Nomad's latest-generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe stands now at 20% off. It might not seem like a lot, but these almost never see any kind of discount.

They feature premium solid metal construction that carries significant weight, paired with a glass finish for an elegant, luxurious place to dock your Apple gear.

The only bummer with this sale is the newly released Cosmic Orange colorway isn't part of the deals:

Rare deals! Nomad Tracking Card: Apple Find My Pro models, Cosmic Orange, Google Find Hub more

Nomad's anniversary sale is now live, and while there was a bit of a false start with Tracking Card Pro and Air, they are now officially available. The discounts aren't huge, but they are rare, with Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions available from $32.

Nomad Tracking Card is one of the best in the business, with wireless MagSafe charging – I take one with me everywhere I go:

  • Tracking Card Air $32 ($35) – Apple Find My or Google Find Hub
  • Tracking Card Pro $41 ($45) – all three colorways

20% off Nomad Titanium Stratos Apple Watch band during anniversary sale (rare discount)

My personal favorite Anker Prime power bank with display that doubles as a wall charger drops to summer low of $70

Anker's 2026 summer sale continues with discounts on the latest Prime charging gear, power banks, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stands, and more. One of my personal favorite portable charging products from the brand has once again dropped to a 2026 low of $69.99 – this 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger.

The 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank is now shipping from Amazon for $69.99. Originally priced at up to $90, we've seen this same discount multiple times this year, but wanted to make sure this deal doesn't slip through the cracks this week since it's the most useful portable charging device in my setup over the past year.

There are certainly more powerful and higher capacity options in the brand's lineup with faster charging output, but this one is super functional for my needs. As one of the smaller models, it easily fits in my everyday carry bag, while still packing an intelligent display, USB-C connections, and enough juice to keep my devices topped off all day and beyond while I'm on the go.

Check out my full hands-on review here.

It's also one of the few models in the lineup that can double as a wall charger. There are foldable prongs built into the back of the power bank that allow you to charge the built-in battery while also using it as a wall charger – I love this design so I don't have to carry an extra device just to top it off.

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • This 140W 4-port charger can power your entire setup from a single wall outlet for $35 today (41% off)
  • Snag this dual Qi charging mousepad that tops off your iPhone and AirPods for $30 (Reg. $70)
  • This 250W Anker Prime charging station with LCD screen that can replace 6 chargers now down to $95
  • Belkin 100W USB-C GaN wall charger drops to Amazon all-time low of $25.50
  • Satechi's newest ChargeView 140W desktop charger with display falls back to Prime Day low at $80
  • Add 4 Matter-certified Edison smart bulbs to your Apple, Google, or Alexa smart home for under $8 each
  • Add some serious ambiance with Matter support to your home with Govee's 3-pack Permanent Outdoor Lights Prism from $430
  • Score DOCKCASE 2-in-1 USB-C SD card reader for just $7 today (47% off) to toss in your tech bag
  • Rare deal: Belkin's 25W UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stand now at Amazon all-time low
  • Still live: Anker's latest 45W Nano charger with intelligent display just $26 today (all colorways)
  • UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My wallet tracker with MagSafe charging just $18 today
  • Grab this magnetic Apple Watch band for $20 (save 41%)
  • Anker 10-port flat plug surge protector now down to $20 at Amazon

Still live: Anker's 3-port 160W Prime charger with smart display falls back to Prime Day price (33% off), more from $8

Beyond the ongoing discounts on Anker's Qi2 25W smart charger with display and the newest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand, we're also seeing the 160W 3-port Prime charger with display drop back down to Prime Day pricing (33% off).

Amazon's official Anker storefront is currently shipping the Smart Display 3-port Prime charger for $99.99.

It's not the cheapest option for what is essentially a wall charger, but it has a built-in smart display and is "about the same size as an AirPods Pro 3 charging case, making it easy to take on the go while still being capable of handling the charging needs for all of your devices" with up to 160W of power output.

More specifically, it can deliver up to 140W from a single USB-C port, capable of "charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro from 0 to 50% in 25 minutes."

As for the smart display, it uses AnkerSense View technology, allowing you to "monitor power output in real time on the screen, switch modes instantly, and unlock custom modes over Bluetooth via the companion app."
